title: Planning run test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized planning-run reducer test without weakening its behavioral proof. Deliverable: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts owns deterministic hashes/witness/state/command/error helpers; planning-run-reducer.test.ts retains creation, readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization coverage; new planning-run-authority.test.ts owns approval, activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive lifecycle coverage. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6 and the stable planning-contract.js facade. NOT in scope: production edits, new behavior, renamed/skipped cases, or reduced assertions. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Every existing planning-run test case and assertion is preserved exactly once across the two test files; no skip/only/todo or assertion loosening is introduced.
The shared fixture module contains only deterministic test construction/assertion helpers and exports no production API.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and test ordering does not create shared mutable state.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0 with production files unchanged.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

Region map (baseline line numbers): 1-17 imports; 18-153 contiguous deterministic helper region; 155-360 describes 1-4 (creation and readiness 4, ownership 4, submission 5, submission finalization 7 = 20 cases); 362-514 describes 5-6 (approval and activation 7, cancellation and concurrency 5 = 12 cases). 20+12=32.

Symbol matrix (word-boundary scan of each region) fixes the per-file imports:
- fixtures must EXPORT: hash, SUBMISSION_HASH, HASHES, READINESS, RESUME, RECOVERY, EFFECT_TERMINAL, REVISION_SEAL, REFUSAL, PLAN_APPROVAL, REVISE, ACTIVATION, CANCELLATION, finalizeWitness, state, commandFor, expectError, expectIllegal, accepted.
- fixtures keep PRIVATE (each still consumed internally, so noUnusedLocals is satisfied): PLAN_HASH, GRAPH_HASH, QUALITY_HASH, DEPENDENCY_HASH, BUDGET_HASH, POLICY_HASH, CLAIM, RELEASE, SUBMISSION, summaries, SEALED.
- reducer half needs value `reducePlanningRun` + type `PlanningRunCommand` only (NOT PlanningRunState/PlanningRunLifecycle/PLANNING_RUN_* /RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES).
- authority half needs values RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES, reducePlanningRun, PLANNING_RUN_COMMAND_KINDS, PLANNING_RUN_TRANSITIONS + types PlanningRunCommand, PlanningRunLifecycle, PlanningRunState.
- fixtures need types PlanRevisionHashes, PlanningRunCommand, PlanningRunCommandKind, PlanningRunLifecycle, PlanningRunReducerResult, PlanningRunState.

Constraints that shape the move: tsconfig.base.json sets noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, verbatimModuleSyntax (type-only imports must say `import type`), exactOptionalPropertyTypes, isolatedModules, declaration. vitest.config.ts include is `packages/**/*.test.ts`, so the fixture module is NOT collected as a suite. Precedent for src-resident fixture modules exists (packages/scheduler/src/test-fixtures.ts, authority/test-fixtures.ts, admission/admission-fixtures.ts); planning/ carries no `.js` shims (only identity/ does), so none is needed. No line-limit or file-inventory guard test exists in the repo.

Projected sizes: fixtures ~150, reducer test ~217, authority test ~168 — all <=250.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Use the task's existing describe-boundary split: the original file keeps the first 20 creation/readiness/ownership/submission/finalization cases; the new authority file receives the final 12 approval/activation/cancellation/concurrency/version/matrix cases; a shared fixture module receives the contiguous helper region. planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The stable planning-contract facade prerequisite task-866713137aee4794a51973fe4e6e3f44 is DONE. planning-run-reducer.test.ts is 514 physical lines with exactly 32 named `it()` cases. Lines 18-153 are a clean shared-fixture responsibility: deterministic hash/witness constants, `summaries`, `finalizeWitness`, `SEALED`, `state`, `commandFor`, and exact rejection/acceptance assertion helpers. Lines 155-361 contain 20 cases in creation/readiness, ownership, submission, and finalization describes; lines 362-514 contain 12 authority/cancellation/concurrency cases. The fixture imports Vitest `expect` only for test assertion helpers and is not collected as a suite because it is not a `.test.ts` file.
planningNotes.risks: The primary hazards are losing, duplicating, renaming, or subtly editing an assertion while moving; separating a derived matrix from its production constants; or introducing shared writes through a fixture module cache. Preserve all 32 names/bodies exactly once, move entire describe blocks, keep `RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES`/transition constants with the authority file that uses them, and keep every fixture binding const with no module-level `let` or writes from tests. Do not add skip/only/todo, export fixtures through package root, touch production sources, or use Unix-only line-count commands. Shared-tree commit must name only the three owned paths.
